study: Pal et al. 2021 EMBO J, human breast atlas
pretraining_overlap_basis: Primary publication not found in CELLxGENE Census 2025-11-08 by DOI, so no evidence of membership in the scGPT corpus. Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence: neither pretraining corpus publishes a per-accession manifest, and TISCH2 re-processes raw GEO submissions that could in principle have entered a corpus by another route.
geneformer_overlap_basis: Genecorpus-30M excluded cells with high mutational burden (malignant cells and immortalised lines), and these are tumour-tissue datasets, so inclusion of the malignant compartment is unlikely. Non-malignant tumour-infiltrating immune cells cannot be positively excluded: the corpus does not publish a per-accession file list. Geneformer-V2 (Dec 2024, ~104M cells) has a broader and less precisely documented corpus than V1, so the uncertainty is larger for V2.
